title: viscago vulgaris
intro: Viscago vulgaris, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the northern hemisphere, particularly in the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. Bearberry is valued for its health benefits, including its diuretic and astringent properties, which can help alleviate urinary tract infections and other urinary issues. The therapeutic actions of Bearberry include its ability to stimulate urination, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Bearberry include arbutin, a glycoside responsible for its medicinal properties, which has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including kidney stones and bladder problems.
